# Data land libraries 

Loading libraries 

```{r, eval = FALSE}
library(tidyverse)
library(p8105.datasets) 
library(plotly) 
library(httr)
library(jsonlite)
library(dplyr)
library(lubridate)


```
 loading data 
```{r}
get_all_inspections = function(url) {
  
  all_inspections = vector("list", length = 0)
  
  loop_index = 1
  chunk_size = 50000
  DO_NEXT = TRUE
  
  while (DO_NEXT) {
    message("Getting data, page ", loop_index)
    
    all_inspections[[loop_index]] = 
      GET(url,
          query = list(`$order` = "zipcode",
                       `$limit` = chunk_size,
                       `$offset` = as.integer((loop_index - 1) * chunk_size)
                       )
          ) %>%
      content("text") %>%
      fromJSON() %>%
      as_tibble()
    
    DO_NEXT = dim(all_inspections[[loop_index]])[1] == chunk_size
    loop_index = loop_index + 1
  }
  
  all_inspections
  
}

url = "https://data.cityofnewyork.us/resource/43nn-pn8j.json"

nyc_inspections = 
  get_all_inspections(url) %>%
  bind_rows() |> 
  janitor::clean_names

nyc_inspections =
  nyc_inspections |> 
    mutate(           #fixing variables
      grade = factor( #transform grade into ordinal factor so it can used in plots
               grade, 
               levels = c("A", "B", "C", "N", "Z"), 
               ordered = TRUE),
        score = as.numeric(score), #transform score into numeric so it can used in plots
        longitude = as.numeric(longitude),#compatible for scatter plot
        latitude = as.numeric(latitude) 
      ) |>
  group_by(camis)|>
        filter(inspection_date == max(inspection_date, na.rm = TRUE)) |> # selecting latest grade
  select(-violation_code) |> #selecting just grade
  distinct(camis, .keep_all = TRUE) #removing duplicates
      

manhattan_inspection_grade = 
  nyc_inspections |> 
  filter( boro == "Manhattan", !is.na(grade)) |> #selecting manhattan restaurants
  
 |>  #compatiable for scatterplot
  mutate(quintile = cut(
     score,
      breaks = quantile(score, probs = seq(0, 1, 0.20)),
      labels = c("Very Low", "Low", "Medium", "High", "Very High"),
      include.lowest = TRUE
    )
  )     
  

  

```

## scatterplot
        
```{r}
nyc_inspections|> 
  mutate(   inspection_date_only = as.Date(inspection_date)) |> 
  filter(boro == "Manhattan", 
         !is.na(longitude), longitude!=0, !is.na(latitude), latitude!=0, 
         critical_flag != "Not Applicable")|>
  mutate(text_label = str_c("Restaurant:", dba, "Inspection Date:", inspection_date_only))|>
 plot_ly( 
    x = ~ longitude, y = ~latitude, type = "scatter", mode = "markers", 
    color= ~critical_flag,  
    colors = c("#EE1289", "#98F5FF"),
        marker = list(size = 4),
    text = ~text_label, alpha = 0.25) |> 
  layout(title = 'Manhattan Restaurant Critical Inspection Statuses')
```


 
 ## boxplot
 
```{r, eval = FALSE}
nyc_inspections |> 
  filter( boro != 0, !is.na(score))|>
  mutate(boro = fct_reorder(boro, score)) |> 
   plot_ly(y = ~score, color = ~boro, type = "box", colors = "viridis")|> 
  layout(title = 'Distribution of Restaurant Inspection Scores by NYC Borough')

```


## barchart 

```{r, eval = FALSE }
nyc_inspections |> 
  filter( boro != 0, !is.na(grade), grade %in% c("A", "B", "C"))|>
  group_by(boro)|>
  count(grade) |> 
  mutate(boro = fct_reorder(boro, n), grade = fct_reorder(grade, n)) |> 
  plot_ly(x = ~boro, y = ~n, group = ~grade, color = ~grade, type = "bar", colors = "viridis")|> 
  layout(title = 'Number of Inspected Restaurants by NYC Borough and Grade',
         xaxis = list(title = "NYC Borough"),  
         yaxis = list(title = "Number of Inspected Restaurants"))


```
